column1: # THE REQUIRED-ROUTE BRANCH LEDGER, AS IT STANDS AT THE ENTRY COMMIT.
# Each branch the route REACHES is classified by WHAT IT DECIDES, not
# by which file it lives in. This is the BASELINE the C1 phase freezes
# and the C2 phase corrects against.
# POLYC_SEMANTIC_OWNER       the compiled PolyC driver decides it; the C
# MECHANICAL_EXECUTION       the C side translates an already validated
#                            PolyC decision into an engine invocation,
# C_SEMANTIC_ENGINE_RETAINED the retained C compiler engine performs its
#                            own internal fault handling; it does not
# C_SEMANTIC_OWNER            a C policy decides something the route
# WHOLE_CLI_OFF_ROUTE         C-owned, but the flag is absent on the
#                            required route, so the branch is not taken
# DORMANT_OR_EXCLUDED         source present but unreachable from the
#                            production path, or excluded at compile time
